snippet.title: CloverPit - Unholy Fusion DLC Shadowdrop Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about CloverPit: Unholy Fusion: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3314790 

The viral and hellish slot-machine roguelite CloverPit drags players back into their cell with its first DLC called 'Unholy Fusion.' Exploit the grotesque Surgery Machine to fuse charms into even more powerful ones. Discover 30 unique charm fusions and push your builds further with new memory cards, synergies, modifiers, and fresh regular charms - and break the game all over again! CloverPit: Unholy Fusion is available now on PC via Steam, Xbox Series, Xbox One, Xbox for PC, and mobile. Alongside the DLC, the base game received the free 1.4 update today for all players to enjoy, bringing online leaderboards to the game!

Follow news and updates on The Triple-i Initiative:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/triple-i-initiative-2026

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/iii_initiative/
Twitter: https://x.com/iii_initiative 

What is the Triple-i Initiative?

We’re simply a bunch of studios banding together to share exciting news to our players, in a short show packed with back-to-back trailers. That’s it - no extra fluff, no ads, no host, just games. We’re talking world premieres, exclusive gameplay, launch dates, demo drops and more!

You can learn more over on https://iii-initiative.com
